newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 10.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China will shortly allow selected state firms to issue four billion yuan worth of convertible bonds as part of efforts to push forward reform of the state sector.
- China has promulgated a set of rules governing the issue of convertible bonds, listing a series of requirements for eligible companies including a minimum of three consecutive years of profits.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Premier Li Peng told the World Congress of International Chamber of Commmer held in Shanghai that China would offer the world $700 billion business in the next four years.
- Experts say China's financial reform is progressing very slowly, preventing the nation from establishing a real capital market.
